paite: Angel ngana in amut a, van a kipan leitung a aksi kia ka mu a; amah kiang ah kokhuk taw nei lou honna chabi piak in a-om hi.
heading: Pengkul Ngana Leh Gukna Mutna
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

paite: Ama'n kokhuk taw nei lou ahong a; huai kokhuk a kipan in meikhu, meipi khu bang mai ahong pawttou a, huai kokhuk a meikhu ziak in ni leh huihkhua hihmial in a-omta hi.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

paite: Huan meikhu a kipan in leitung ah khaupete ahong suak ua; aikamte'n thilhihtheihna aneih bang un amau thilhihtheihna piak in a-om uhi.
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

paite: Amau leitung a loupate, thil hing himhimte leh sing peuhmahte, hihse lou a, mi kuapeuh atal ua Pathian chiamtehna neiloute kia hihse dia hilh in a-om uhi.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

paite: Amau that lou ding a, kha nga sung amau hihgenthei zaw ding a hilh in a-om ua; huai a hihgentheihna tuh aikam in mi kuahiam ateh a ahihgentheih bang ahi.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi'n sihna azong ding ua, bangchi mah in amu kei ding uh; sih a-ut ding ua, himahleh sihna in amau ataimangsan ding hi.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

paite: Huan khaupete kilatdan sakol kidouna a pang dia bawl bang ahi ua; alutung uah dangka-eng lallukhu hileh kilawm a-om a, amai uh mihingte mai bang ahi.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

paite: Numei sam bang sam anei ua, aha uh humpinelkai ha bang ahi.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

paite: A-awm uah sik awmphawte bang anei ua; akhazap ging uh kidouna lam a sakol tampi tai dupdup, kidouna kangtalai tampi ging bang ahi.
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

paite: Huan aikam bang in meigu nei anei ua, mihingte kha nga sung hihnatna ding in amei uah thilhihtheihna anei uhi.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

paite: Amaute'n kokhuk taw nei lou neitu angel atung ua kumpipa in anei uhi; ama min Hebru pau in Abaddon ahi a, Grik pau in Appolion ahi.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

paite: Tunggikna masapen abeita a, ngai in, tunggikna nih tunung chiang in ahong tung lai ding hi.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

paite: Huan angel gukna in amut a, Pathian ma a om dangka-eng maitam kii a kipan in aw ka za a;
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

paite: huai aw in angel gukna pengkul nei kiang ah, "Euphrates luipi lianpi a angel li hen a omte phel in," achi hi.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

paite: Huan mi mun thum a khen mun khat athahtheihna ding ua dak khat, ni khat, kha khat leh kum khat sung kisa a na om, angel lite phel in a-om uhi.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

paite: Huan sakol tungtuang sepaih atamdan uh sing ngen mun singnih ahi chi a atamdan uh kigen ka za hi.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

paite: Huchibang in kilakna in sakolte leh atung ua tuangte, mei bang a san, engdup leh kaat bang a eng, awmphaw neite ka mu hi; sakolte lu humpinelkai lu bang ahi ua; akam ua kipan in mei leh meikhu leh kaat asuakkhia hi.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

paite: Huan akamsung ua kipan a hong pawtkhia huai hipi thum, mei, meikhu leh kaat in mihing mun thum a khen mun khat thah in a-om uhi.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

paite: Huai sakolte thilhihtheihna akam uh leh amei ua om ahi a; amei uh gulpi mei toh akibang ua, lu leng anei ua, huaite in mi ahih na uhi.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

paite: Huan midang huai gawtna a siloute akhut ua sepkhiakte ah akisik tuan kei ua; dawite, dangka-engte, milimte, dangka milimte, suang milimte leh sing milimte; mu theiloute, za thei lou leh tang theiloute be nawn lou ding in akisik tuan kei uhi.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

paite: Huan atualthahna uh, ami bumna uh leh akingaihna khelhna uh leh aguktakna uh akisik tuan kei uhi.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
